videos.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
videos.description: Sonic tries to navigate the complexities of life on Earth with his newfound best friend, a human named Tom Wachowski. They must soon join forces to prevent the evil Dr Robotnik from capturing Sonic and using his powers for world domination.

videos.title: Rat Race

videos.title: Spies in Disguise
videos.description: A charming super spy and his geeky scientist companion are almost exact opposites. But what the scientist lacks in social skills he makes up for in invention, creating awesome gadgets for the spy to use on his epic missions.

videos.title: Uncharted
videos.description: Treasure hunter Victor Sullivan recruits Nathan Drake to help him recover a 500-year-old fortune. What starts out as a heist becomes a globe-trotting, white-knuckle race to reach the prize before the ruthless Santiago Moncada can get his hands on it.

videos.title: The Mechanic
videos.description: Ace assassin Arthur Bishop becomes a target when he agrees to teach reckless Steve the art of contract killing.

videos.description: In the 1980s Hollywood, adult film star and aspiring actress Maxine Minx finally gets her big break. However, as a mysterious killer stalks the starlets of Los Angeles, a trail of blood threatens to reveal her sinister past.

videos.title: The Gunfighter
videos.description: The vengeful brothers of a man he killed in self-defence force a retired gunslinger to take up arms once again.

videos.title: Wild Horse Nine Interview Special
videos.description: Writer and director Martin McDonagh as well as the cast discuss the Film4-produced political comedy thriller`Wild Horse Nine'.

videos.title: Tooth Fairy
videos.description: Nicknamed the 'Tooth Fairy' due to his penchant for knocking out other players' teeth, an arrogant hockey player's moniker becomes very apt when he steals a dollar that his girlfriend Carly's daughter has left for the real Tooth Fairy. Sprouting wings, Derek is summoned to meet the leader of the fairies, Lily, who labels him a 'dream crusher' and orders him to serve as a tooth fairy to make up for his transgressions.

videos.title: Deck the Halls
videos.description: Steve Finch has the best Christmas in town, until brash salesman Buddy Hall moves in next door and puts in so many lights that his house can be seen from space. Cue a battle to decide who achieves seasonal supremacy.

videos.title: Sister Act
videos.description: A Reno lounge singer-turned-murder witness transforms a group of singing nuns into an unconventional convent choir.

videos.title: Sister Act 2: Back in the Habit
videos.description: Sequel in which a nightclub singer is asked to get back into her habit when her old friends at St Catherine's Convent find difficulty in controlling a school filled with juvenile delinquents. Convincing everyone that she is a nun is going to be a challenge in itself, especially with a group of incompetent monks trying to hinder their efforts.

videos.title: Braveheart
videos.description: William Wallace is the medieval Scottish patriot who is spurred into revolt against the English when the love of his life is slaughtered. Leading his army into battles that become a war, his advance into England threatens King Edward I's throne before he is captured and executed, but not before becoming a symbol for a free Scotland.

videos.title: The Killing Fields
videos.description: The true story of 'New York Times' reporter Sydney Schanberg and his efforts to locate his Cambodian friend and translator Dith Pran after he was captured by the brutal Khmer Rouge while working for Schanberg in Cambodia in 1973. The film follows Pran's efforts to survive the Khmer Rouge regime and the purge of the country that took Cambodia into 'Year Zero'.

videos.title: Imitation of Life
videos.description: A widowed but rising actress, Lora Meredith, hires Annie Johnson as her black housekeeper. Johnson too has a daughter, who is light-skinned enough to pass for white. Tensions rest on the relationship each mother has with her growing child as they both reach maturity, find love, and face up to the death of a loved one.

videos.title: Halls of Montezuma
videos.description: In the midst of World War II, US Marines are sent on a reconnaissance patrol to a Japanese-held island in the Pacific. The mission is to track down a rocket and capture the Japanese for questioning.

videos.title: To Hell and Back
videos.description: Audie Murphy was the most decorated American soldier of World War II, including the Medal of Honour among the 27 US decorations he received. Amid the bravery (single-handedly knocking out a German machine gun nest, almost single-handedly holding up a tank advance), he also found time to have a little romance with an Italian girl named Maria.

videos.title: Bridge of Spies: Interview Special
videos.description: Director Steven Spielberg and stars Tom Hanks and Mark Rylance talk about making their Cold War espionage drama.

videos.title: Bridge of Spies
videos.description: The CIA recruits a lawyer in order to negotiate the immediate release of a captured, and imprisoned U.S. pilot.

videos.title: Wrath of Man
videos.description: A new security guard for a cash truck surprises his co-workers when he unleashes precision skills during a heist, and the marksman's ultimate motive becomes clear as he takes dramatic and irrevocable steps to settle a score.

videos.title: Commando
videos.description: The ex-leader of an elite military task force is pressed back into service when his daughter is kidnapped.

videos.title: Joyland
videos.description: One day, Haider finds work as a dancer in a cabaret. He falls in love with one of the star dancers, Biba, a transgender woman. For her part, his wife Mumtaz finds it hard to bear his less and less free life.
